(1) Hold versus evolve (internal block F1-B; told in the card and the technical note of Observation 1): evolving the true first map removes 47.8% of the error of holding it on TACO (3.48 → 1.82, paired interval excludes zero) and 3.2% on ARCTIC (2.21 → 2.14, paired interval includes zero). The second sentence of the paragraph ('We read this as contact dynamics depending on the interaction regime (the test sets also differ in composition), not as a failure of either dataset.') is a reading, not a tested cause: the test sets also differ in size and composition.
